name: Sahel insurgency
value: Insurgency sustained; no capital newly fallen
summary: JNIM and IS Sahel keep fighting in Mali and Burkina Faso; air and drone strikes in Mali have doubled since April
state: An analysis reported by Reuters on 19 Nov found that air and drone strikes by Malian and Russian Africa Corps forces have more than doubled since the April 2026 insurgent offensive, with recorded strike deaths up nearly 150% (Moscow Times). JNIM and Islamic State Sahel Province continue to fight state forces and each other in Mali and Burkina Faso. Searches on 19 Nov found no new fall or blockade of a capital or major city and no new mass-casualty attack in a coastal state, so Watch holds.
for_you: Residents of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger face attacks, blockades and air strikes. FCDO advises against all travel to most of the region. Fuel and food supply routes into the region stay exposed.
rubric_hit: Sustained insurgency; no capital or major city fallen or blockaded and no new coastal-state mass-casualty attack (Watch)

sources.title: The Moscow Times (Reuters) — Russia's Africa Corps deploys new drone in Mali as strikes increase, analysis says

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
